children.value: > Fact From Story At a time when the tech industry in Israel is disrupted due to political events, Palo Alto Networks is acquiring Israeli tech company Dig Security for an estimated $400 million.

> > Fact From Story Palo Alto Networks’ stock price has been on the rise on the back of strong earnings and growing demand for cybersecurity services, and now the company is using that momentum to do a little shopping.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Companies often use their strong financial position to acquire other companies.
> Commonsense Knowledge $400 million is a significant amount of money.
